## The directive extension is not attached

These examples run with NO feature attached, as the cmark gate runs the base
layer against its oracle, and attachment is the only gate there is (Q14). They
are a harness-internal proof that a registered feature can be excluded for a
comparison, and nothing more: the dialect has no switch, so no consumer can ask
for this parse. The extension's syntax is ordinary Markdown here.

The file was once named after a parser option that no longer exists, and its
title said "attach the extension without enabling its parser option", which it
could never have shown -- the ctest entry passes no `--feature`, the examples
carry no tags, and the runner starts from nothing attached. An oracle that
cannot tell "attached, option off" from "not attached" is the gap D1 lived in
for eleven releases.

```````````````````````````````` example
Use :cite[smith04] here.
.
Document scope=1:1..1:24 children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:24 children=1
    └── Text scope=1:1..1:24 literal="Use :cite[smith04] here." children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
::youtube[Video]{vid=01ab2cd3efg}
.
Document scope=1:1..1:33 children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:33 children=1
    └── Text scope=1:1..1:33 literal="::youtube[Video]{vid=01ab2cd3efg}" children=0
````````````````````````````````
